sections.title: Transport eligibility
sections.text: Cedar Systems employees on rostered night shifts are eligible for regular cab transport. Day-shift employees are not eligible for regular cab transport.

sections.title: Night shift safety escort
sections.text: All Cedar Systems employee drops after 9 PM require a security escort regardless of gender. An escort is not required by this rule for a drop exactly at 9 PM.

sections.title: Booking and change cutoff
sections.text: Cedar Systems cab bookings and shift changes must be requested at least 1 hour before the scheduled trip. Late exceptions require the duty manager's approval.

sections.title: Weekend and holiday travel
sections.text: Cedar Systems provides Saturday, Sunday and public holiday pickups for rostered night shifts without additional manager approval.

sections.title: Airport trip approvals
sections.text: Cedar Systems does not offer airport cab trips under the employee transport policy. Employees must use the separate business travel process.

sections.title: No show penalties
sections.text: At Cedar Systems, each no-show incurs an INR 100 penalty. Two no-shows within a calendar month do not suspend cab booking access.

sections.title: Guest travel
sections.text: Guests and family members may not use Cedar Systems employee cabs, including on weekend and holiday trips.

sections.title: Ad hoc trip requests
sections.text: Cedar Systems ad hoc office cab trips require duty manager approval and have a cost cap of INR 600 per trip.
